proposals.evidence: Turner lists Kumaoni ṭhūlo and Nepali ṭhulo large, alongside the wider thūl-/ṭhūl- series under sthūla. Dotyali ṭhulo/thulo and Kullu thulə preserve this th-l large adjective; the source dental versus retroflex spelling is retained. The assignment concerns the regional inherited adjective family and does not normalize the attested vowels.
